stroke_se.poolable_reason: k=1 ON THE QUESTION THIS PAGE ASKS. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18. NCT00262600 (RE-LY) is the trial that established dabigatran in atrial fibrillation and its registered primary is the yearly event rate for stroke or systemic embolism. NCT04532528 (ReAHEAD) is not a drug trial at all: BOTH its arms receive dabigatran and the randomisation is between an educational intervention and standard care, with a registered primary of 'Number of Patients With High (MMAS-8 Score: 8 Points) Adherence to Dabigatran Treatment'. IT ASKS WHETHER EDUCATION IMPROVES ADHERENCE, NOT WHETHER DABIGATRAN WORKS. Averaging an adherence outcome with a stroke outcome is not a pool of one question, so one trial remains and a single trial is reported as a single trial. WHY THIS TOPIC WAS NEARLY RETIRED FOR THE WRONG REASON, recorded because the near miss matters: subject_is_experimental_gate returned FAIL here, because RE-LY types ALL THREE of its arms ACTIVE_COMPARATOR and ReAHEAD types neither of its arms at all. Read by hand, dabigatran is unambiguously the intervention in RE-LY. THE GATE TOLD US WHERE TO LOOK AND WAS WRONG ABOUT WHAT WE WOULD FIND, which is exactly what a gate is for and exactly why a verdict is not a reading.

stroke_se.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that the contributing trial is poor -- it is registered, randomised and reports its primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that this page holds one trial that answers the question its title asks.
stroke_se.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
stroke_se.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
stroke_se.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: Dabigatran in atrial fibrillation: NOT POOLABLE -- k=1 on the efficacy question, and the second trial asks about ADHERENCE on Stroke or systemic embolism?

It examines 1 randomised trial and DOES NOT POOL THEM.

The outcome sought is Stroke or systemic embolism.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

bookkeeping_2026_08_21._what: The five reporting claims a PRISMA-2020 manuscript needs that are FETCHABLE rather than argued -- each derived from a field here, or stated as an honest absence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_limbs_this_review_refuses: Of the four properties this project requires of a completed topic, 0 are held (none) and 4 are refused with the obstacle named in the evidence (comparison denominator, grade per pool, model output verbatim, rob per result).
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.the_search_its_date_and_its_databases: PRIMARY TRIALS. NO BIBLIOGRAPHIC SEARCH FOR PRIMARY TRIALS WAS RUN. The 2 included trials were identified by reading named registrations on 2026-08-18; Every registration read in full on 2026-08-18, including armsInterventionsModule.armGroups[].type and interventionNames[], and the brief title. Arm TYPE alone was not sufficient on either topic and the reading says why.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.whether_this_review_was_prospectively_re: NO PROSPERO REGISTRATION OR PROTOCOL RECORD IS HELD ON THIS OBJECT. That is not the same as knowing this review was not registered, and neither claim is made. It is recorded here as an absence so that a reader does not have to infer it from silence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.that_two_assessors_disagreed_and_where: NO SECOND, INDEPENDENT RISK-OF-BIAS ASSESSMENT IS RECORDED FOR THIS TOPIC. The judgements were made once. Stated so that single assessment is not mistaken for agreement between two.
